## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this pull request and the problem/feature it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior changes
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: Adding or updating tests
- [ ] `chore`: Build/dependency maintenance

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Backend tests pass: `./mvnw test`
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly: `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual verification in browser

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style guidelines.
- [ ] I have added/updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or unnecessary dependencies are included.
- [ ] Commits adhere to Conventional Commits format.
